goal: Find the 3 most recent posts on Anthropic's news page and summarize each in one sentence with links.

result.summary:
The 3 most recent Anthropic news posts:

1. **[An update on independent evaluators](https://www.anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-independent-evaluators)** (Oct 15, 2026): Anthropic has begun giving a METR team employee-like access to assess its models and safety practices, and is also working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators.
2. **[Preparing for the 2026 US midterms](https://www.anthropic.com/news/2026-us-midterms)** (Oct 14, 2026): Anthropic outlines how it has strengthened its election safeguards ahead of the US midterms.
3. **[Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore](https://www.anthropic.com/news/singapore-office-opening)** (Oct 14, 2026): Anthropic opened a Singapore office and signed an MOU with the government to advance safe, responsible AI adoption.

rows.Title: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore

issues: The midterms and Singapore posts were summarized from the related-content blurbs on the first post, not by opening them.
Their order relies on the related-content section, so the ranking of the two Oct 14 posts is unverified.
